evidence_distinction: P70-P75 produced one successful independent case, so evidence progress was real. They did not improve the development model or provide estimable external R2. P76 completed an available internal data-addition test and found no candidate passing matched regression checks.

directions_reviewed.direction: Continue the same public blind-paper search
directions_reviewed.evidence: P70-P75 yielded one scored independent primary-scope source, zero high-BET sources; P74/P75 record inaccessible publisher or author manuscripts and multiple 2E cycling protocols.
directions_reviewed.decision: Pause repeated autonomous search until access or qualified evidence changes.

directions_reviewed.direction: Convert a ready local development curve, then test data addition
directions_reviewed.evidence: LS-NC-600 now provides seven early points plus one author endpoint. Sixty fixed fits completed, no warnings/failures. P67 same-old20 MAE and R2 regressed; P64 MAE also slightly worsened.
directions_reviewed.decision: Completed here; retain both raw evidence and failed candidate, keep the archived model.

directions_reviewed.direction: Reopen broad model or parameter screening
directions_reviewed.evidence: P65-P69 already retain model/shape/scope/weight comparisons; this round identifies no new mechanism or input information that justifies another grid. These experiments do not prove every possible model has been exhausted.
directions_reviewed.decision: Defer until new information supports a discriminating test.

directions_reviewed.direction: Acquire informative same-test curves or original numerical tables
directions_reviewed.evidence: Independent source count1 and high-BET count0 prevent assessing external R2 and subgroup performance; current graph readings have non-negligible uncertainty.
directions_reviewed.decision: Recommended external improvement; ask for two currently inaccessible candidate PDFs and SI first, verify protocol before deciding whether to resume.

not_established: The causal reason for failing R2>0.95 is unresolved. More articles or more rows cannot be promised to increase accuracy; the local library has not been proven exhausted.
resume_evidence: A newly available candidate containing qualifying curves or materially better numerical data supports a concrete next test. First assess exact test, early points, basis, target and source identity; then freeze the smallest useful plan. Newly acquired candidates are not automatically in scope.

reporting_policy.round_unit: One bounded research question with actual inputs, result and direction decision, not a tool call or check count.
